# Social Media Hashtag Research

The Apify actor [`apify/social-media-hashtag-research`](https://apify.com/apify/social-media-hashtag-research) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.15**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract information about posts across social media with the same hashtag.  Get details from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook about posts’ URLs, captions, timestamps, likes, dislikes, views and comments count, and basic profile info. You can download your data in JSON, CSV, Excel, and more.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/social-media-hashtag-research) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-social-media-hashtag-research@0.0.15#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      hashtags: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hashtags` | array | yes |  | Hashtags — List of hashtags on any social network |
| `socials` | string[] | yes |  | Socials — Selection of social networks, that the hashtag will be searched for |
| `maxPerSocial` | integer |  | `10` | Max results per site — Maximum number of results to return per social network |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
